title: Starfish Prime / Bluegill Triple Prime EMP

tellings.quote: Bluegill Triple Prime was four years before where we incidentally created an EMP in the Starfish Prime series.

plain: Michels says that in 1962, during a run of high-altitude nuclear test blasts over the Pacific called the Starfish Prime series, the United States accidentally created an EMP, an electromagnetic pulse: a burst of energy that can knock out electronics. He mentions one blast, Bluegill Triple Prime, as coming four years before another event he refers to, and he tells this himself, without naming a source, during a 2026 debate with a skeptic.
